finding: Pivot ownership floor(j*ranks/n) does not invert the floor(n*rank/ranks) row-update boundaries at non-divisible sizes. For n=513 and 128 ranks, row 4 is updated by rank 1 but selected and broadcast by rank 0, whose copy has not received those updates. Many subsequent boundary rows have the same mismatch.
observed_failure: The 128-rank check exits 1 through MPI_Abort on rank 35 during factorization. The pinned source invokes this abort when it computes a nonpositive diagonal. The paired Opus 5.5 check passes in 11.239979 seconds; the failing execution exits in 15.354108 seconds and does not time out.
interpretation: This is a pre-existing ownership/numerical defect, not a scheduling failure. The original-to-effective source diff only reduces and prints the maximum duration, leaving all affected ownership and factorization code unchanged. Retain the failed external-validation disposition without a retry.
investigation: Static inspection, original/effective source diff, retained stderr, and the paired passing execution; no retry.
